sections_affected: Insertion of Section 3G; Amendment of First Schedule (Serial No. 17)
summary: Establishes a body corporate known as the Sammakka Sarakka Central Tribal University in the State of Telangana under Section 3G of the Central Universities Act, 2009 to provide avenues of higher education and research facilities primarily for the tribal population of India.
full_text:
THE CENTRAL UNIVERSITIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2023
NO. 36 OF 2023
[17th December, 2023.]
An Act further to amend the Central Universities Act, 2009.
BE it enacted by Parliament in the Seventy-fourth Year of the Republic of India as follows:—
1. (1) This Act may be called the Central Universities (Amendment) Act, 2023.
(2) It shall come into force on such date as the Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, appoint.
2. In the Central Universities Act, 2009 (hereinafter referred to as the principal Act), after section 3F, the following section shall be inserted, namely:—
“3G. There shall be established a Tribal University, which shall be a body corporate, to be known as the Sammakka Sarakka Central Tribal University, having its territorial jurisdiction extending to the whole of the State of Telangana, as specified in the First Schedule to this Act, to provide avenues of higher education and research facilities primarily for the tribal population of India.”.
3. In the First Schedule to the principal Act, after serial number 16 and the entries relating thereto, the following serial number and entries shall be inserted, namely: —
"17. Telangana Sammakka Sarakka Central Tribal University - Whole of the State of Telangana.".

principal_act: The Coastal Aquaculture Authority Act, 2005 (24 of 2005)
sections_affected: Section 2, Section 4, Section 7, Section 7A, Section 9A, Section 11, Section 12, Section 12A, Section 13, Section 13A, Section 14, Section 14A, Section 22A, Section 24, Section 25, Section 27, Section 28
summary: Amends the Coastal Aquaculture Authority Act, 2005. Expands definitions to include modern technical aquaculture facilities, replaces criminal penal provisions with a graduated civil monetary penalty regime, establishes Adjudicating Officers and Appellate Authorities, empowers the Authority to enforce biosecurity and prohibit harmful materials (Sec 12A), and retrospectively validates coastal aquaculture permissions under CRZ regulations from 19th February 1991.
full_text:
THE COASTAL AQUACULTURE AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2023
NO. 27 OF 2023
[12th August, 2023.]
An Act amend the Coastal Aquaculture Authority Act, 2005.
BE it enacted by Parliament in the Seventy-fourth Year of the Republic of India as follows:—
1. (1) This Act may be called the Coastal Aquaculture Authority (Amendment) Act, 2023.
(2) Save as otherwise provided, it shall come into force on such date as the Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, appoint; and different dates may be appointed for different provisions of this Act.
2. In section 2 of the Coastal Aquaculture Authority Act, 2005... Definitions added for aquaculture input, aqua mapping, aqua zonation, biosecured facility, biosecurity, Brood Stock Multiplication Centre, coastal aquaculture unit, Nucleus Breeding Centre, operator, owner, pharmacologically active substance or antimicrobial agent.
3. Section 4 & 7: Ministry representation updated (Ministry of Earth Sciences, MoEFCC, Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Commerce & Industry, Fisheries Animal Husbandry & Dairying).
4. Section 7A & 9A: Creation of Secretary of the Authority as CEO and constitution of specialized committees.
5. Section 11 & 12: Regulation of aqua mapping, aqua zonation, environmental standards, biosecurity surveillance, and assessment of environmental damage costs.
6. Section 12A: Prohibition of harmful pharmacologically active substances or antimicrobial agents in coastal aquaculture.
7. Section 13 & 13A: Registration procedures, permitted zones, and appointment of Assistant Directors as authorized officers, Under Secretaries as Adjudicating Officers, and Deputy Secretaries as Appellate Authorities.
8. Section 14 & 14A: Substitution of criminal imprisonment with a structured graduated financial penalty table (₹5,000 to ₹1,00,000) and statutory appeal procedure.
9. Section 22A: Costs and penalties recoverable as arrears of land revenue.
10. Section 27 & 28: Retrospective CRZ exemption for coastal aquaculture back to 19th February 1991 and validation of statutory permissions under Environment (Protection) Act, 1986.

act_name: The Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi (Amendment) Act, 2023
principal_act: The Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi Act, 1991 (1 of 1992)
summary: Amends GNCTD Act 1991. Expands LG's sole discretion powers under Section 41 and inserts Part IV-A (Sections 45A to 45H) establishing the National Capital Civil Service Authority (NCCSA) chaired by Chief Minister Delhi with Chief Secretary and Principal Home Secretary as members to recommend transfers, postings, vigilance, and prosecution sanctions for Group A and DANICS officers serving GNCTD, with final overriding discretion vested in the Lieutenant Governor.
full_text:
THE GOVERNMENT OF NATIONAL CAPITAL TERRITORY OF DELHI (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2023
NO. 19 OF 2023
[11th August, 2023.]
An Act further to amend the Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi Act, 1991.
BE it enacted by Parliament in the Seventy-fourth Year of the Republic of India as follows:—
1. (1) This Act may be called the Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi (Amendment) Act, 2023.
(2) It shall be deemed to have come into force on the 19th day of May, 2023.
2. In section 2 of the principal Act, inserted definitions for Lieutenant Governor and Minister.
3. In section 41 of the principal Act, 'act in his discretion' substituted with 'act in his sole discretion'.
4. Insertion of Part IV-A (Sections 45A to 45H):
- Sec 45A: Definitions including All India Services (except IPS), DANICS, Authority, Group A officers, Group B/C officials.
- Sec 45B: Public Service Commissions - UPSC for Group A/B gazetted; DSSSB for Group B non-gazetted & Group C posts.
- Sec 45C: Power of Central Government to make rules regarding tenure, salary, selection, penalties, and transfers.
- Sec 45D: Appointment of authorities, boards, commissions by President or LG on recommendation.
- Sec 45E: Constitution of National Capital Civil Service Authority (NCCSA) consisting of Chief Minister (Chairperson), Chief Secretary (Member), and Principal Home Secretary (Member-Secretary).
- Sec 45F: Meetings of Authority; quorum of 2 members; CM presides.
- Sec 45G: Appointment of officers and staff to assist Authority.
- Sec 45H: Powers & functions of Authority - recommending transfers, postings, vigilance proceedings, and prosecution sanctions for Group A & DANICS officers to the Lieutenant Governor. LG holds final authority to accept, return for reconsideration, or override recommendations.
